author: dazhatz
quote:
I'm giving gta6 a score of 1 purely for the lighting. The story is incredibly bland and you will find yourself skipping cut scenes you haven't even seen yet because they are so long and tedious. Clunky controls and animations will get you killed often, and the bs girlfriend narrative running constantly will destroy any fun you would normally get from a GTA title. 

Ignore the high bot scores here with their fake reviews... the game is trash. Avoid.
